text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: The testers... have sharply plummeted!?

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why...?! It was bustling and so lively 
just the other day?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, we've also received reports that many 
people are currently withdrawing their 
passport applications for shuttle trips to 
Tracen Island...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... did something happen at 
the academy?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tucker Brine and the Umamusume 
launched an investigation into Tracen 
Academy! As a result, a single rumor 
surfaced—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Tucker Brine is trying to conquer the 
world"... What?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What on earth is that!?

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, just look at this! It's 
an old video of Tucker Brine...!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blind?
text_block_list.text: "...Ahem. Tucker, it's brine..."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blind?
text_block_list.text:
"Umm... we have new insights regarding the 
enhancement of athletic performance 
brought about by ipsilateral 
innervation... From Diagram A—"

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Her vibe is totally different from 
now, isn't it? It's like her entire 
personality changed...!

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, all this stuff about 
"burn your soul" and "unleash your 
instincts" is just weird! And developing a 
deserted island is weird, too!

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Nobody really knows who she actually is! 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's totally plotting something evil, I 
know it! Like taking command of all 
Umamusume to conquer the world...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, no, what are you talking 
about?! That guy is just building a 
training facility with all seriousness, 
you know?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the person in this video and 
Tucker-san are completely different 
people! Like, maybe they're twins, or 
maybe the video is a total fake to begin 
with—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, Tucker-san ain't a bad 
person, and this person ain't Tucker-san! 
Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: W-Wah... that's MEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~ !?

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-T-T-T... Tucker Brine!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Is that true!? Tucker-san!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is you! You look completely 
different from how you do now!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, she occasionally 
ended her sentences with polite speech a 
few times. I wonder if that had something 
to do with it too."
choice_data_list: I'd like to ask as well

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya see... How do I even explain 
this, uhhh...—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...No! There's no point talking about it 
here! If it's going to get out anyway, I 
should make sure as many ears hear it as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And so, on short notice! We're holding a 
Tucker Brine talk show!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Brine... You mean THE Tucker 
Brine!? The one trying to conquer the 
world!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I've heard the rumors about me! Feel free 
to ask me anything that's on your mind 
today! —Though, before that!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"...For the sake of everyone who has 
supported us, there is a misunderstanding 
that must be cleared up. First, please 
hear me out..."

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I knew it...! They're the exact same 
person!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The item itself that was rumored about is 
authentic. However, as for why her 
personality changed like this... The 
reason is... really nothing grand at all.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...Back when the uninhabited island 
project had just gotten underway... I 
often thought about what I currently 
needed.

text_block_list.name: Tucker from That Day
text_block_list.text:
On this Tracen Island, I want Umamusume 
to... liberate their bodies and minds, and 
run purely on instinct.

text_block_list.name: Tucker from That Day
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there are all kinds of girls... 
Some can unleash it when they run, while 
others might not be able to let go so 
easily..."

text_block_list.name: Tucker from That Day
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I must first become wild...! 
I must become an existence that has 
unleashed both body and soul—!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a result of constantly striving 
to be wilder and wilder day after day—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ………………And this is how it turned out!

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: F-For THAT kind of reason!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*murmur murmur*...!?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
B-But look! It just shows how much they 
care about Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, exactly! She's totally the type 
who'd do anything for someone precious to 
her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of someone precious." 
Indeed, thinking back to Tracen Island, 
that makes total sense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A long-term development plan with 
virtually no precedent. To take command in 
an inconvenient place with neither water 
nor electricity and build a training 
facility—
choice_data_list: That's just how much I love Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With that, the bustling cafeteria 
instantly fell dead silent.

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: A-Are you—
choice_data_list:
I'm a participant in the Deserted Island 
Project!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, reflecting on everything I had 
seen of Tucker Brine so far—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I poured my heart out to tell the 
gathered girls about how she spearheaded 
the island's development and dedicated 
herself for the sake of all Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>...!

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I was developing an uninhabited island to 
explore the potential of Umamusume even 
further...

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What, Mr. Tucker's actually a nice 
guy!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I was wondering how it'd turn out, 
but... Thank you! Thank you so very much!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
They saw me off with smiles at the end! It 
seems the misunderstanding was completely 
cleared up!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The testers will be back soon enough! 
Everything is solved! Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curtain closed on what seemed to be a 
resounding success! ...Yes, at least at 
this moment.
